dataset: Aurora Instruments research tasks across the demo library
description: Tasks for DocPilot's Research mode over all five demo documents: answers that combine documents, conflicts where a newer document supersedes the knowledge base, near-duplicate passages, and two tasks the library can't answer.

fields.task: What the user asks Research mode to do
fields.reference: A correct answer, written by a person; the grader checks the system's answer against it
fields.evidence: Where the answer's evidence is: "file#page", or "file" for anywhere in it. A run should find passages for all of them
fields.key_figures: Figures a correct answer must state, checked in code (commas and $ ignored)
fields.answerable: false when the library doesn't contain the answer

items.task: How much does a SkyNode Pro cost, and how much is the Plus cloud plan per year?
items.reference: Since the pricing update effective 1 September 2026, the SkyNode Pro costs $319 (the 2026 knowledge base lists the earlier $299) and the Plus plan costs $59 a year ($5.99 a month), up from $49.

items.task: A school wants 6 SkyNode stations: 4 at the main campus (has Wi-Fi) and 2 at a field site with no Wi-Fi. Students need wind direction and UV readings. Recommend the models and cloud plan, and estimate the first-year cost with the education discount.
items.reference: 4 SkyNode Pro at the campus (the Lite has no wind direction or UV sensor) and 2 SkyNode Max at the field site (only the Max has cellular backup). At current prices: 4 x $319 + 2 x $529 = $2,334. The Schools Program Guide gives 40% off hardware for orders of 3 or more stations, so hardware is $1,400.40. Plus now allows only 4 stations, so one Pro plan (up to 10 stations) is needed: $129 a year, $77.40 after the 40% discount. First-year total: $1,477.80.

items.task: A vineyard with no mains power and no Wi-Fi wants soil moisture readings and a full year of data history. What equipment and plan do they need, and what will the first two years cost?
items.reference: A SkyNode Max ($529): it is the only model with soil moisture sensors and the only one with cellular. A SolarKit ($79) powers the hub without mains power and fits the Pro and Max. The Plus plan gives a year of history at $59 a year, so $118 over two years. Cellular data is included for the first 12 months; the second year needs the Aurora Cellular plan at $30 a year (cheaper than $3 a month). Two-year total: $529 + $79 + $118 + $30 = $756.

items.task: Can I run a SkyNode Lite on the SolarKit at a site without mains power?
items.reference: No. The SolarKit fits the SkyNode Pro and Max hubs only; the Lite hub takes power through a different connector and needs mains power. For a site without mains power, choose a Pro or Max with the SolarKit ($79).

items.task: Does the SkyNode Lite support 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
items.reference: It depends on the hardware revision. Revision B Lite hubs (serial numbers starting LB-, shipping since January 2026) support 5 GHz Wi-Fi, added in a firmware update. Revision A hubs (serial numbers starting LA-) have a 2.4 GHz radio only, which matches the knowledge base's 2.4 GHz specification.

items.task: We're a Title I school and want 2 weather stations. What can we get free, and what discount applies if we buy them instead?
items.reference: Through the Station Grant, Title I schools can get up to 2 free SkyNode Lite stations per school year; applications open on 1 February and are decided by 31 March. Buying 1 or 2 stations instead gets 15% off hardware (the 40% hardware discount needs 3 or more stations).

items.task: Our school is ordering 4 SkyNode Pro stations. Do we get the hardware discount, and what will the stations cost?
items.reference: Yes. Since 1 September 2026 the 40% hardware discount applies to orders of 3 or more stations (the knowledge base's earlier rule required 5). At the current $319 each, 4 stations are $1,276 at list, or $765.60 after the discount.

items.task: After the first year, what does cellular data for a SkyNode Max cost, and which billing option is cheaper?
items.reference: The first 12 months of cellular data (up to 1 GB a month) are included. After that the Aurora Cellular plan costs $3 a month or $30 a year, so annual billing is cheaper: $30 against $36 a year.

items.task: What does the SolarKit cost in euros, and is it sold in the EU?
items.reference: The library gives the SolarKit's price only in US dollars ($79) and doesn't say whether it is sold in the EU or what it costs in euros.

items.task: When is the SkyNode Ultra launching, and what will it cost?
items.reference: The library doesn't mention a SkyNode Ultra. It describes only the Lite, Pro and Max.
